# OpenFreeMap style notices

Source: https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles

The OpenFreeMap styles project is MIT licensed. Map data is from
OpenStreetMap. OpenMapTiles code is BSD 3-Clause and its design is CC BY 4.0.

The Liberty style is a fork of https://github.com/maputnik/osm-liberty.
OSM Liberty is a fork of OSM Bright. OSM Bright code is BSD 3-Clause and its
design is CC BY 4.0.

The Maki POI icon set is CC0 1.0 Universal. The right-arrow icon derived from
Wikipedia is public domain. Natural Earth map data is public domain.
